headline: 839 cases in 24 hours: Five more die from dengue in Bangladesh
summary: Daily cases have surged past last year's levels as the country faces a growing health crisis.
details: Bangladesh is seeing a sharp rise in dengue fever cases, with 839 new infections recorded in the last 24 hours alone.
Tragically, five more people have died from the virus, adding to the rising death toll as the outbreak spreads.
Health officials report that the current surge in cases has already surpassed the levels recorded during the same period last year.
Medical facilities are under pressure as the number of patients requiring hospitalization increases rapidly.
Authorities are urging the public to maintain strict precautions against mosquito breeding to curb the spread of the virus.

headline_marked: 6 million [[Bangladeshi CVs offered for sale]] on dark web
headline: 6 million Bangladeshi CVs offered for sale on dark web
summary: A hacker group claiming to have stolen data from BDJobs is advertising the sale of millions of resumes, sparking fears of widespread phishing and fraud.
details: A hacker group identifying themselves as 'Madarx' has posted an advertisement on the dark web offering to sell the CVs of 6 million Bangladeshi citizens.
The group claims that this massive database was stolen from BDJobs, one of the country's largest job portals.
The advertisement was published on a website called 'DarkForums.ru' on Sunday afternoon.
In response to the claims, BDJobs has denied that any data leak occurred from their website.
Cyber security experts have warned that such a leak poses a significant risk, as the personal information in CVs can be used for phishing and financial fraud.
caption:
6 million CVs of Bangladeshis are allegedly up for sale on the dark web. Could your personal data be among them?

The advertisement was published on a website called 'DarkForums.ru' on Sunday afternoon.

In response to the claims, BDJobs has denied that any data leak occurred from their website.

Cyber security experts have warned that such a leak poses a significant risk, as the personal information in CVs can be used for phishing and financial fraud.
